system.name: DiffPuter
system.one_liner: A diffusion model combined with the EM algorithm that imputes missing tabular values by alternating model fitting (M-step) and conditional sampling (E-step).

content.variant_note: a toy table with missing cells is redrawn at every hand-off; the EM loop is two dashed boxes (M step, E step) joined by Sync arrows, and the path turns back along the bottom to the completed table
content.argues: Imputation can be run as EM with a diffusion model: fit the model on observed plus current imputed data, then re-estimate the missing entries, for K iterations.
content.subject: A small age, education, income table with missing cells followed through one-hot encoding, mean imputation, K EM iterations, argmax and decoding.

elements.name: x
elements.role: the raw table with missing entries: columns age, education, income; rows such as 40, NaN, > 50K
elements.drawn_as: rounded-frame mini table; missing cells (NaN) in dashed boxes; '...' row and column for more data

elements.name: One-hot encoding
elements.role: turns the categorical education column into edu1, edu2, edu3 (discrete to continuous, per the caption)
elements.drawn_as: label above an arrow and a table with columns age, edu1, edu2, edu3, income; NaN cells in dashed boxes

elements.name: Base mean imputation
elements.role: initialises the missing entries with the mean of the observed values
elements.drawn_as: label above a table whose columns are tinted green (age), lilac (edu1 to edu3) and yellow (income), missing cells filled with boxes labelled mean

elements.name: First iteration
elements.role: marks the hand-over of the initialised table to the first M step
elements.drawn_as: label on a long curved black arrow into the loop

elements.name: M step
elements.role: fix x^mis and estimate the diffusion model parameters theta
elements.drawn_as: dashed rounded box with the title M step, a blue box 'Diffusion Model: p_theta(x)', a table (x^obs, x^mis) with pink cells and a caption 'Fix x^mis, estimate theta' on an upward arrow

elements.name: E step
elements.role: fix theta and estimate x^mis by conditional sampling
elements.drawn_as: dashed rounded box with the title E step, a pink box 'Diffusion Model: p_theta(x)', a table (x^obs, x^mis) with blue cells and a caption 'Fix theta, estimate x^mis' on a downward arrow

elements.name: Sync theta / Sync x^mis
elements.role: pass the fitted parameters to the E step and the new estimates back to the M step
elements.drawn_as: two short labelled black arrows between the dashed boxes, one to the right at the top, one to the left at the bottom

elements.name: K iterations
elements.role: the M and E steps repeat K times
elements.drawn_as: label above the two dashed boxes

elements.name: argmax
elements.role: turns the estimated one-hot probabilities into hard categories
elements.drawn_as: label on a black arrow running left along the bottom, to a table whose chosen cells (0 0 1 / 1 / 38) are blue

elements.name: One-hot decoding
elements.role: maps the one-hot columns back to the original education values
elements.drawn_as: label on a black arrow running left to the last table

elements.name: x*
elements.role: the final imputed table, returned from the E step of the last iteration according to the caption
elements.drawn_as: rounded-frame mini table with the imputed entries (12th, > 50K, 38) on blue cells, at the lower left

The final imputation result x*is returned from the E-step of the last iteration.

summary: DiffPuter is a diffusion model combined with Expectation-Maximization for missing data imputation on tabular data: it trains the model on observed plus current imputed data (M step), then updates the missing entries by conditional sampling (E step). Figure 1 follows one toy table of age, education and income with missing cells: one-hot encoding, base mean imputation, then K iterations of two dashed boxes, an M step with a blue diffusion-model box and an E step with a pink one, joined by Sync theta and Sync x^mis arrows. The result passes through argmax and one-hot decoding to the completed table x*. The table is redrawn at each hand-off with the changed cells tinted, so the numbers can be followed by hand.
summary_zh: DiffPuter 把扩散模型和 EM 算法结合做表格缺失值填补。图1用含缺失值的玩具表格依次经独热编码、均值填补，进入 K 轮 M 步（训练模型）与 E 步（采样补值）的循环，最后经 argmax 和独热解码得补全表 x*。
notes: Prior kinds kept (stage-pipeline closed-loop, worked-walkthrough). arrangement is other because the path is a clockwise loop with a return row. M step and E step are treated as containers of one drawing, not panels. The cell colours (pink in the M-step table, blue in the E-step table) and the source of the argmax arrow are read from the picture only; the caption says the result comes from the E step of the last iteration.
